3.name: Animal Speaker
3.notes: You can cast the Beast Sense and Speak with Animals spells, but only as Rituals. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for them.

3.name: Rage of the Wilds
3.notes:
When you activate your Rage, choose one option.

Bear: You have Resistance to all damage types except Force, Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant while your Rage is active.

Eagle: When you activate your Rage, you can take the Disengage and Dash actions as part of that Bonus Action. While raging, you can take a Bonus Action to take both of those actions.

Wolf: While raging, your allies have Advantage on attack rolls against enemies within 5 feet of you.

6.name: Aspect of the Wilds
6.notes:
Choose one option. You can change this choice whenever you finish a Long Rest.

Owl: You have 60-foot Darkvision. If you already have Darkvision, increase its range by 60 feet.

Panther: You have a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

Salmon: You have a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

10.name: Nature Speaker
10.notes: You can cast Commune with Nature as a Ritual. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for it.

14.name: Power of the Wilds
14.notes:
When you activate your Rage, choose one option.

Falcon: You have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed while raging if you aren't wearing armor.

Lion: Enemies within 5 feet of you have Disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than you or another Barbarian using this option.

Ram: While raging, when you hit a Large or smaller creature with a melee attack, you can give it the Prone condition.
